description: List share codes. Pass `tag` (id or name) to list one tag's codes, or omit it to list every share code in the space. Revoked codes are included, flagged `revoked`.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

tag.description:
tag optionally narrows to one tag's codes (an id or a name). Omit to list
 every share code in the space. Revoked codes are included.

name: list_share_codes

code.description: code is the secret the holder enters at `url` to be admitted.

expired.description: expired is true when expires_at has passed (the code no longer admits).

expiresAt.description: expires_at is when the code stops admitting; unset means it never expires.

hasPin.description:
has_pin is true when the code carries a second-factor PIN (the PIN itself is
 never returned).

label.description: label records who the code is for - it identifies the holder's feedback.

locked.description:
locked is true when the code is locked out after too many wrong PINs; it
 admits nobody until unlocked.

revoked.description: revoked is true when the code has been revoked (no longer admits).

url.description:
url is the anonymous view page for the code's tag, where the holder enters
 the code. Absolute when the app base url is configured, else a /v path.

title: Share links that exist
